help: Sets a colony's size directly, up to 15. Updates the population condition, the Arcology World or Ecumenopolis stage and the planet's look. Uses the colony you are docked at if no name is given.
Installs an Omega core administrator on a colony without using up an Omega core.
Runs the Great Civil War on a colony at once: size 8, decivilized subpopulation, stability hit.
Sets how far a colony has grown towards its next size, in percent. 99 makes it grow within days, if it is allowed to grow.
Shows a colony's size, size limit, growth, administrator, stage and AoTD scaling.
